about.title: About Me
about.p1: Software engineer with more than 7 years of experience working mainly in backend with Java and Spring Boot, developing APIs and evolving applications towards microservices architectures.
about.p2: Throughout my career I have participated in internal and client projects for international clients, which has allowed me to work in collaborative environments, with agile methodologies and with a clear focus on software quality, testing and best practices.
about.p3: In recent years I have also taken a more active role within teams, supporting other developers, reviewing code and helping in technical decision making, in addition to my experience as a tutor in bootcamps, where I have accompanied junior profiles in their professional growth.
about.p4: I am particularly interested in continuing to evolve towards roles with greater impact on product and architecture, where I can not only develop solutions, but also participate in their design, scalability and continuous improvement.
about.p5: I consider myself a consistent person, with an analytical mindset and team-oriented, who enjoys understanding problems in depth and seeking simple, maintainable and quality solutions.
